aiRiskScore.title: AI Risk Score
aiRiskScore.description: Optional AI-generated risk or confidence score for the claim.

estimatedAmount.title: Estimated Amount
estimatedAmount.description: Optional override. If omitted, amount = Product WC_Product_Amount__c + (labour hours × WC_Labour_Charge_per_hour__c). If that computes to zero, this value is used when provided.

faultDescription.title: Fault Description
faultDescription.description: Customer or dealer description of the fault or symptom.

labourHours.title: Labour Hours
labourHours.description: Estimated labour hours for the repair line.

mileageAtClaim.title: Mileage At Claim
mileageAtClaim.description: Odometer reading at time of claim, if known.

productId.title: Product Id
productId.description: Product2 Id for the claimed part

vin.title: VIN
vin.description: 16-character VIN; must match the vehicle from lookup.
